concept: A dark night-street poster becomes a physical audit trail. The opening title collides from opposite sides, a five-card rail advances one lime-selected state at a time, and the rail compacts into an abstract receipt card with no fabricated transaction data.

beats.action: Opposing title words align, then the composed title accelerates left into the chain.
A vertical rail advances PEDIDO, QR, ESCANEO, MATERIAL and FACTURA; one current step is lime while completed links fill orange.
The compacted rail resolves as an abstract receipt card, the public-proof line lands, and the final frame holds still.
